methods.label: Last student's allocation
methods.explanation: There are \(3x+8\) books in total. The last student receives \(3x+8-5(x-1)=13-2x\) books. Write \(1\leq13-2x<5\), which gives \(4<x\leq6\). Since \(x\) is an integer, \(x=5\) or 6.
methods.levelReason: Uses Grade 7 expression construction, simplification, linear inequalities, and selection of integer student counts.
